I am planting cassava on this my small 0.05 hectare plot, and buying one bag of NPK fertilizer is too much money for only this small land, so I will not buy it. Instead I will carry the chicken manure I have been keeping behind the house and spread it there, because it costs nothing and I have seen it work well before. I will plant the cassava stems I kept from last harvest since they always grow here, and I have not seen any neighbor plant those new varieties to know if they are good. My children and I will clear the plot, make the heaps, plant, and weed it ourselves; the rain here is steady so I will not irrigate or waste money on chemicals.
